column3: Appointing the despised is presented as a question.
Brother is singular in the Greek, not plural “brothers.”
Wronging and cheating are reordered; “own” is supplied.
The two terms soft and male-bedders are combined as “men who submit to or perform homosexual acts.”
Making Christ’s members members of a prostitute is rendered as uniting them with her.
“Himself” and “with her” make the joining and bodily unity explicit.
Having the Spirit is rendered as having “received” Him.
